findings.finding: Concurrent cold or expired project-file lookups duplicated directory scans after the initial executor offload.
findings.response: Reproduced with counted real walks; added per-folder OnceLock cache generations and expiry/isolation coverage.

findings.finding: Strict HTTP body length checks could reject valid HEAD or304 responses with representation metadata.
findings.response: Reproduced; reader/parser now use request method and bodyless status semantics; strict ordinary-body validation retained.

limits: The full audit validation counts are recorded separately; independent review checks overlap them.
Live SSH, relay, other operating systems and release packaging were not exercised.

rounds.verdict: No in-scope blockers; the duplicate scan finding is fixed and the bodyless HTTP follow-up introduces no new regression.
inspected: Per-folder cache generation selection, expiry, pruning, panic recovery, cross-folder independence and tests
HEAD/204/304 bodyless response handling and strict ordinary HTTP framing
rounds.independently_exercised: Standalone OnceLock panic/retry model confirmed another waiting caller can initialize after a panic without poisoning the global lock.
limits: Final native Cargo integration coverage remained with the parent run, not the reviewer.
Optional test-name/evidence editorial nits were not correctness blockers.

rounds.scope: Node 22 CI fixture follow-up; production code unchanged
rounds.verdict: No blockers; observable waits preserve ownership assertions and explicit seed cancellation strengthens coverage.
mutation_checks: Removing the post-ticket generation guard makes stale-socket detection fail on Node 22 (three of three runs) and Node 26.
Removing the unauthorized-path connect-promise reset makes both retry tests fail.
rounds.method: Reviewer used an isolated temporary source copy for mutation checks; the working production source was not edited.

accepted_behavior: Skipping app-state initialization also stops its event subscriptions; resuming fetches a fresh snapshot.
Closing a remote PTY now explicitly terminates and reaps its owned child outside the manager mutex.
connect() shares the first connection promise; current call sites connect once per transport.
scope_preserved: Unused merge-store removal retains backend commands and public frontend wrappers.
